tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: THE brand pink: selected chips, tiles and segments, active tab, toggles, checkboxes, slider fill, the end of every CTA gradient. White on primary is 3.6:1 (the brand's own pairing) — keep labels on it 16px semibold or larger; for pink TEXT use primary-text.

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary fills and buttons.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Pink as text or a thin icon ("Guardar", "Saltar", links, chip labels on light) — 4.7:1+ on background, surface, card and light. An accessible companion to primary added for text.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-dark and the CTA gradient.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Coral: start of the CTA gradient (secondary → primary). Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Orange: Premium crown, lightbulb tips, the warm gradient. Fill or icon, never body text — use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text ("Premium", "Popular") on accent-soft, card and background.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Premium / Popular badges and tip cards with an orange icon.

tokens.name: light
tokens.usage: Soft pink fill: tertiary button, pink badges (Nuevo, Match, distance), slider track, pressed rows.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Screen background behind every page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tinted areas inside a screen: segmented-control track, tip card, add-photo slots, disabled fields.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, inputs, unselected chips and choice tiles, tab bar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the 1.5px edge of cards, inputs, chips and tiles.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that must read as a control (radio off, toggle off outline when needed) — 3:1 on card and background.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on background, surface, card and light.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, row labels, inactive tab labels, hints. 4.7:1+ on background, surface and card.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholders in fields. 4.9:1 on card.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Online / active dots, field success border, check icons. Fill only — use success-text for words.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success as text ("En línea", "Correcto") on card, background and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and the rewind action. Always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning as text.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error border and alert icon on fields; destructive actions. Always with words.

tokens.name: error-text
tokens.usage: Error messages under fields.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind error toasts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Verified badge, super-like star, info icons.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: "Verificado" and info text on info-soft and card.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Verificado badge.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button and field fill.

tokens.name: on-disabled
tokens.usage: Label on a disabled control (exempt from contrast rules; never use for live text).

tokens.name: apple
tokens.usage: "Continuar con Apple" button fill (Apple's guideline: black on light, white on dark).

tokens.name: on-apple
tokens.usage: Label and mark on the Apple button.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Bottom fade on photos so name and distance read; modal backdrop.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Round buttons floating over photos (the heart on a profile card, remove ×).

tokens.name: on-photo
tokens.usage: Text and icons over a photo, above scrim.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: grad-primary-start
tokens.usage: Primary gradient start (pink). Primary gradient = grad-primary-start → grad-primary-end, 135°: hero banners, Premium, the match card.

tokens.name: grad-primary-end
tokens.usage: Primary gradient end (magenta-purple).

tokens.name: grad-warm-start
tokens.usage: Warm gradient start (orange). Warm gradient: promos, boosts.

tokens.name: grad-warm-end
tokens.usage: Warm gradient end (pink-red).

tokens.name: grad-soft-start
tokens.usage: Soft gradient start: empty states, onboarding backgrounds.

tokens.name: grad-soft-end
tokens.usage: Soft gradient end.

tokens.name: grad-dark-start
tokens.usage: Dark gradient start (violet): night mode promos, Premium Plus.

tokens.name: grad-dark-end
tokens.usage: Dark gradient end.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The Corazones logotype beside or under the heart. Splash, auth, marketing.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Onboarding step titles, page titles inside content.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Name on a profile card, modal titles.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Top-bar titles and section headers (Información básica, Intereses).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Amante de la música, los viajes y las buenas charlas.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Values in list rows, names in lists.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Subtitles under titles, chip labels, helper text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Row labels above values, badges, timestamps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in badges, label-to-value in list rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, photo tiles and choice tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in rows and fields; tile padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above the bottom CTA; around empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small badges, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, photo tiles, interest tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, choice tiles, CTA buttons, tip cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Profile cards, match card, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, toggles, segmented control, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, toasts, swipe buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Primary CTA, selected choice tile, the like button.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Small round buttons over photos, toggle thumbs, slider thumbs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Fields, default buttons, segmented control.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom CTAs (Continuar, Ver más opciones), auth buttons.

tokens.name: tabbar
tokens.usage: Tab bar height above the safe area.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in chips and badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in fields, rows and buttons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tab bar, top bar, choice tiles.

tokens.name: avatar-xs
tokens.usage: Inline mentions, stacked likes.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Chat header, compact lists.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Chat list rows.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Match card, new-matches row.

tokens.name: avatar-xl
tokens.usage: Own profile header.

tokens.name: action-md
tokens.usage: Secondary swipe actions.

tokens.name: action-lg
tokens.usage: Pass and like.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed ghost and link controls.
